frame_adapter: one logistic calibration head per method, trained on official EgoCart Train only
SSR: frozen source vacancy detector + product detections + predicted-NGI DSI proposals when loadable + geometry topology proposals + train-only frame calibrator
structure_subset: input-only applicability subset: >=12 product detections, >=2 dense rows, horizontal product span >=35%; no EgoCart Test GT used
strict_point_localization: reported only as diagnostic because EgoCart supplies approximate OOS center points rather than boxes
